birds.name: Chrome Raven
birds.description: Low horizontal raven fuselage, hooked black beak, compact triangular cyan optic, swept titanium blade wing and four cyan tail blades. White swept brow and ventral cyan light retain the original steel/cyan identity.

birds.name: Prism Hummingbird
birds.description: White and gold upright mechanical raptor with raised wing on an exposed ivory forearm, layered gold-edged blue crystal blades, two swept gold crests, narrow cyan lens and separate faceted cyan tail fan. Wing body pivot (352,199) must bridge to outer hub around(285,151).

birds.name: Koiwing Glider
birds.description: Red/gold phoenix-shaped frame, broad magenta energy pinions and forked pink flame tail, three swept flame crests, large black curved cyan optic and magenta shoulder/ear reactors. Distinctive bright yellow ventral flame panel.

birds.name: Verdant Kite
birds.description: Oversized ivory/green rounded helmet with a small green lens and downward black hook beak, short lime/cream leaf-shaped wings, large three-leaf tail fan, layered swept green crests and luminous lime chest reactor. Exposed green wing forearm bridges body pivot≈(288,248) to hub≈(250,214).

birds.name: Solara
birds.description: Black segmented hawk fuselage with red armour, a short hooked gold beak, asymmetric swept red flame crest, red-orange pennant wings and a broad golden flame tail. Keep the amber optic small and set into the dark mask.

birds.name: Astra
birds.description: Cobalt and cyan crystalline flight bird with long downward teardrop primaries, a narrow gold needle beak, gold shoulder/coverts, white throat and belly, and a swept cyan-cobalt crest.

birds.name: Voltcrest
birds.description: Compact white and cobalt shell with alternating cyan and magenta elongated crystal primaries, gold clamp hardware, small bright cyan eye, a split cyan/magenta crest and a long fine gold beak.

birds.name: Chromaflux
birds.description: Large layered magenta-and-white wing fan, swept twin gold crown horns, black facial mask with a small pink optic, white neck shield and long luminous pink tail plumage. Gold is structural trim rather than overall shell.

birds.name: Virex
birds.description: Streamlined pink-magenta bird with white scalloped coverts, many narrow pointed primaries, three short gold/pink crown spikes, rose optic and long gold structural feather edges. Distinguish its fine pointed fan from Chromaflux broad layered fan.

birds.name: Borealis
birds.description: Dark violet mechanical hawk. Low swept hooked head, small violet almond sensor, layered swept violet crown, broad black-chrome shoulder collar, downward violet fan of narrow articulated blade-feathers and a separate split magenta tail plume. Preserve the dark shell and restrained silver shoulder highlights.

birds.name: Roselight
birds.description: Emerald and lime mechanical hawk. Long luminous swept crest and compact hooked beak; bright green small round optic; broad leaf-like emerald primaries with long lime inset facets, pale shoulder/collar blades and a widely forked green tail. The existing Roselight name deliberately uses green reference artwork.

birds.name: Pyrestorm
birds.description: Cobalt and ice-cyan mechanical bird with a white cheek, pointed blue swept crown, small cyan optic and silver hooked beak. Long broad blue primaries carry cyan faceted insets and three short ivory covert blades. The tail is a separate wide cyan plume with a silver nozzle collar. Existing Pyrestorm artwork is blue.

birds.name: Nightveil
birds.description: Narrow dark emerald stealth hawk with a small lime almond optic, three slim swept crown blades, a tight ivory cheek/collar and long knife-like green wing blades. This silhouette is narrower and more tapered than Roselight; pale dagger-shaped coverts and a long compact fork tail distinguish it.

birds.name: Ionwing
birds.description: Round-faced ivory mechanical owl/finch with a domed ivory helmet, larger vertical violet/cyan optic, small short gold hooked beak, swept violet/cyan crown, bright titanium shoulder cap, broad prismatic cyan-violet tail and long curved multicolour pinions. Unlike the four preceding hawks it must keep its rounder white face and fuller belly.
